findings.summary: Cascading Eligibility Traces use a state-space cascade to preserve temporally precise local eligibility over arbitrary delays and demonstrate behavioral-timescale credit from seconds to minutes. Long-delay/history-sensitive local credit therefore does not itself require explicit lineage tokens or a novel computational principle.
sources: Raharison Ralambomihanta et al., Learning From the Past with Cascading Eligibility Traces, arXiv:2506.14598 (2025)
Izhikevich, Solving the Distal Reward Problem through Linkage of STDP and Dopamine Signaling, Cerebral Cortex 17(10), 2443-2452 (2007)

findings.summary: A 2026 preprint models locally diffusing error/neuromodulatory signals in recurrent spiking networks and reports improved learning under sparse feedback connectivity relative to eligibility propagation. Spatially distributed local credit circulation is therefore another ordinary physical mechanism class that future lineage claims must distinguish from.
sources: Barretto-Bittar, Levina, Giannakakis & Zeraati, Diffusion of Neuromodulators for Temporal Credit Assignment, arXiv:2603.08949 (2026)

findings.summary: RUDDER redistributes delayed returns toward salient earlier state-action events, while Temporal Value Transport uses explicit memory reads to send future value back to remote events. These are strong functional delayed-credit reductions, but they use stronger trajectory/global-memory privilege and should be treated as privilege-tiered ceiling baselines rather than automatically equal-privilege mechanistic reductions.
sources: Arjona-Medina et al., RUDDER: Return Decomposition for Delayed Rewards, NeurIPS 2019
Hung et al., Optimizing agent behavior over long time scales by transporting value, Nature Communications 10, 5223 (2019)

novelty_or_reduction_impact: STRONGER_REDUCTION_PRESSURE: delayed and temporally precise local credit can be implemented by cascading eligibility-state dynamics; sparse local credit can use diffusive neuromodulatory signals; and delayed reward can be redistributed or transported by stronger-privilege sequence/memory mechanisms. A future Spark-specific residual should be actual-cause-specific allocation among temporally/spatially co-eligible histories under matched privilege, not delayed/history-sensitive credit itself.
